about.title: About Buy My Skills
about.subtitle: Connecting talent with opportunity worldwide
about.story1: At Buy My Skills, we believe talent should have no boundaries. Our platform connects individuals with unique skills to businesses and people who need them. Whether you're a freelancer looking to showcase your expertise or an employer searching for the right talent, Buy My Skills makes it simple, transparent, and effective.
about.story2: From technical services to creative arts, from business consulting to everyday tasks — every skill has value, and we're here to help you share it with the world.
about.story3: Our mission is to empower individuals, support businesses, and build a community where skills become opportunities.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Transform your expertise into opportunities. Join thousands of professionals connecting globally.
howItWorks.offerTitle: 🚀 Offer Your Expertise to the World
howItWorks.offerDescription: Buy My Skills connects your skills with your local community, city, and country. Whether developer, designer, consultant, or expert in any field, our intelligent regional filtering system ensures you connect with relevant opportunities while protecting your data privacy.
howItWorks.localDescription: Connect with clients in your region for easier collaboration and local opportunities.
howItWorks.regionalDescription: Expand within your region while maintaining local connections and cultural understanding.
howItWorks.dataDescription: Region-based filtering keeps your information secure within trusted geographic boundaries.
howItWorks.step1Description: Sign up and create a compelling profile showcasing your skills, experience, and what makes you unique. Add your photo and detailed description to stand out.
howItWorks.step2Description: Choose your preferred work style (remote, on-site, or hybrid) and specify when you're available. Set your rates and project preferences to attract the right clients.
howItWorks.step3Description: Get discovered by clients browsing our platform. Respond to inquiries, discuss project details, and start working on exciting opportunities that match your expertise.
howItWorks.globalDescription: Connect with clients from around the world. No geographical boundaries limit your opportunities.
howItWorks.flexibleDescription: Set your own schedule and work preferences. Choose projects that fit your lifestyle and expertise.
howItWorks.secureDescription: Your data is protected with industry-standard security. Safe and reliable transactions.
howItWorks.fairDescription: Set competitive rates for your services. Get paid for the value you provide to clients.
howItWorks.sarahQuote: Found 3 major projects in my first month. The platform made it easy to showcase my React expertise.
howItWorks.mikeQuote: Connected with international clients. The profile system helped me stand out from the competition.
howItWorks.annaQuote: Perfect for consultants! Found steady work analyzing data for businesses across different industries.
howItWorks.ctaDescription: Join thousands of professionals who are already earning through their expertise. Your next big opportunity is just a profile away!
howItWorks.faq1Question: How much does it cost to join?
howItWorks.faq1Answer: Joining Buy My Skills is completely free! You only pay when you successfully complete projects.
howItWorks.faq2Question: What types of skills are in demand?
howItWorks.faq2Answer: From software development and design to consulting, writing, and specialized services - our platform supports a wide range of expertise areas.
